actions.name: Astro Bomber (Resolution)
actions.description:
Effect: The user designates a landing zone. Anything in the landing zone, or in a cylinder immediately up from the landing zone, is attacked by the user as they descend from orbit, afflicted with @Affliction[grounded 5] and is pushed out of the landing zone as though by the appropriate @Trait[push-x] effect.

Note: Given the nature of this attack, it is not compatible with the @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-abilities.chYPNMfgv36IywNz]{Cavalry Charge} ability.

actions.name: Astro Bomber (Set-Up)
actions.description: Effect: The user gains +1 Attack Stage and +1 Speed Stage for 5 activations, and then leaves the field until it's next activation (leave the token on the canvas and treat it as untargetable).
